hypothesis_or_artifact: H1 - Section 8 inference: the multiplicity correction and the decision rule it feeds
label: DERIVED
claim_quote: "Three co-primaries, distribution-free, one-sided, at\n**alpha_adj = 1 - 0.95^(1/3) = 0.016952 (0.0170)** each. **All three must\npass for the Stage B GO row.**" (NPLExperiment/REGISTRATION.md:200-202)
evidence_summary: The decision rule is implemented as a conjunction: 'all_co_primaries_pass=p1.passes and p2.passes and p3.passes' (src/npl/verdict.py:201). A Sidak correction is a union-type adjustment: it controls the probability that at least one of several tests rejects. Under an all-must-pass (intersection-union) rule the GO decision rejects only when every component rejects, so its type-I error under any configuration in which at least one component null is true is bounded by the LARGEST per-component level, and no correction is required. Applying Sidak therefore makes each component strictly harder and the GO strictly harder than the registered family-wise budget requires. The same repository applies the correct reasoning to its successor hypotheses - 'H2 and H3 require every co-primary (the weakest governs); H4's grid is disjunctive within the hypothesis (Sidak-corrected), so its best cell governs' (src/npl/register/cull.py:18-20, implemented at cull.py:135-144) - and applies no within-hypothesis correction to H2's two required co-primaries, reserving Sidak for H4's union of three cells (register/conditioning.py:sidak_within; registrations/H4/REGISTRATION.md:79-80). H1 is the only place in the program where a union correction is attached to a conjunction. Direction: the correction makes the conjunction harder to pass, i.e. makes the FAIL that H1 fired easier to reach, which is why the direction is A rather than B. Consequence: nil at these counts - see the recomputation.
evidence_refs: NPLExperiment/src/npl/verdict.py:201 (all_co_primaries_pass=p1.passes and p2.passes and p3.passes) and :67-82 (clopper_pearson_lower)

Method: re-run each component at an uncorrected alpha = 0.05 using verdict.py:clopper_pearson_lower and power.py:upper_tail, cross-checked against scipy.stats.beta.ppf and scipy.stats.binom.sf. Scripts: /home/kiros-li/.cache/program-audit/scratchpad/work/agentC-npl/misc.py; re-run at consolidation. Result: P1 exact lower bound rises 0.5706880326738533 -> 0.5840855403520515, still below the 0.60 bar -> FAIL; P2 p = 1.000000 -> FAIL; P3 p = 3.767e-05 -> PASS. THE H1 VERDICT DOES NOT MOVE. Tolerance 1e-6 (the stored statistics themselves reproduce to 1e-15).
